title: Starting from the conclusion: the inverted pyramid

videos.script: Think about how you read a news story. The first sentence tells you what happened. If you stop there, you still know the news. {{news}} Now think about how most analyses are presented. First the data source. Then the cleaning. Then the method. The finding arrives at minute nine, if the meeting lasts that long. {{analysis}} That is the order the work was done in. It is not the order anybody needs to hear it in. {{order}} This lesson turns it around. The conclusion goes first, in one sentence. Then the structure from lesson two follows, so the room knows where the argument is going while it listens. {{flip}} And it ends with the place this matters most and gets the least care. The subject line of an email. {{email}}
